notes: Answers: jurisdiction is 'Jurisdiction, date of formation' (e.g. 'Delaware, 03/12/2025'). fein is the EIN as printed '12-3456789' (nine bare digits look like an SSN and are never written), or 'not available' to tick the box. principal_office: 'street, city, ST ZIP' (a US address also gets country USA; a foreign address goes whole on the street line). agent: an organization's name, or a person's full name (told apart by a company word). agent_address: 'street, city, TX ZIP' (TX is printed). governing_persons: one per line, 'Name, street, city, ST ZIP', up to three on the form (more go on an addendum); a line whose name has a company word goes on Organization Name, otherwise First/M.I./Last. effectiveness: one of the options; 'Later date (within 90 days): 11/01/2026' or 'Future event: <event>' also fills the date or event box. signer: 'Name' or 'Name, date': only the printed name is written; the date box gets the signing date when the form is signed. Signature left for the signer; supplemental provisions box left blank.
